phone.notes: PvP leagues no longer keep anybody out: any Digimon can fight in any league, and one of a higher stage than the league fights as its earlier form of that stage (only in the fight). If something breaks or feels unfair, tell us in Discord with /bug or /suggestion. Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: The watch face can show the data you choose (date, heart rate, battery...) and has a new plate. The steps past the daily limit of the tamer now give coins (from the server). If something breaks or feels unfair, tell us in #bug-reports.

phoneStore.notes: The open world is here: walk the city with your Digimon, buy a plot, build and decorate your house, fight wild Digimon, beat the city boss together to become President, and join guild missions, rankings and tournaments. Seven PvP leagues with daily prizes. Farm, Dex and Storage are one tap away on the Digivice. Requires Android 13 or newer.
